subject: Myth & Symbolism
title: Ritual as Myth in Action
description: A fast breakdown of Ritual as Myth in Action for builders.

hook.text: A Catholic priest lifts bread and says 'This is my body.' Myth becomes real through ritual action.

buildup.text: Ritual enacts myth. It doesn't just tell a story—it makes participants live inside the story.

discovery.text: Mircea Eliade called this reenactment. Every ritual repeats the original mythic event.

twist.text: Without ritual, myths become just stories. Ritual keeps them alive as felt experience.

climax.text: Myth tells you what happened. Ritual makes it happen again, here and now, to you.

punchline.text: Stories are told. Rituals are lived.

quiz.question: What does ritual do to myth according to Eliade?
options: It reenacts and relives the myth
